mountMs.includes: root, generated shell, and dispatcher setup plus initial lists; excludes shared row-data creation and OXC build time

validity: Each timed transition changes exactly one query source. React uses memoized child regions with stable rows; the handwritten VDOM rebuilds both regions; the compiled path rebuilds only the region reached by the changed source. The graph's shared rows source fans out to both regions and is tested separately. Every intermediate output and retained keyed-node identity is checked outside timing. Six arm orders are balanced. Mount is reported separately; paint/presentation and compiler build time are excluded.
